candidate_relations.reason: The episodes are initiated by very short-coupled PVCs at rest with a normal baseline ECG and no documented exercise or catecholamine trigger. An RyR2 variant of unknown significance does not establish CPVT.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different polymorphic ventricular arrhythmia subtype: CPVT rather than short-coupled PMVT/VF variant of idiopathic ventricular fibrillation.
